messages:
mike_devops: CI nightly 'infra-deploy' is red — decrypt step failing with Vault errors, looks like token revoked. anyone seen this?
jen_platform: seeing same on main. logs show `vault: token revoked` at the step that reads secrets for deploy.
ci-bot: Nightly job infra-deploy failed (exit 1) — logs: https://ci.redwood/teams/infra/runs/1766204300
mike_devops: can someone rerun the job? I can rotate credentials but want to be sure which secret is the culprit — approle vs GH secret?
david_sre: it's the Vault approle used by the ci-runner. we rotated approle creds last night but didn't update GH repo secret with new secret_id. i'll take this.
maria_eng: if david updates GH secret, rerun should clear most failures. also maybe add a preflight decrypt check in CI to catch this earlier.
jen_platform: david — pinged you the repo link and which env secrets to update. i'm opening a tiny PR to make the decrypt step fail noisier for faster triage.
david_sre: updated GH secrets: `VAULT_APPROLE_ID` and `VAULT_APPROLE_SECRET_ID` in repo settings. requesting a rerun now.
mike_devops: rerun requested: https://ci.redwood/teams/infra/runs/1766204300/retry
ci-bot: Manual re-run started by mike_devops for infra-deploy #1766204301
mike_devops: one job passed but the artifact-store decrypt still fails with `permission denied` when calling KMS decrypt.
jen_platform: artifact creds are a KMS-encrypted blob. logs show `googleapi: Error 403: Permission denied, permissionDenied` during `gcloud kms decrypt` call.
alex_security: checking IAM audit — I see an IAM change at 2026-03-14T02:10:12Z: serviceAccount: ci-runner@redwood-infra lost `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` on projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/ci-key.
david_sre: re-granting role now (roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key for ci-runner).
mike_devops: can we avoid blowing up all nightly jobs? i'd prefer rerunning only the failing job.
jen_platform: ci-bot supports targeted retry; i've queued just the failed job.
david_sre: permissions restored. please kick the final job.
mike_devops: manual retry done. ✅ all stages passed. thanks.
jen_platform: :thumbsup: i'll add alerting in the runbook: when approle secret rotates, ensure GH secret is updated. also add a decrypt preflight during nightly.
maria_eng: suggestion: schedule a daily refresh of `secret_id` or automate pushing new secret_id to GH secrets to avoid drift.
david_sre: makes sense — our rotation policy was 7d; i'll shorten to 24h for secret_id and add automation to push to repo secrets via the ops-runner with a signed step.
mike_devops: filing follow-ups: (1) preflight decrypt test, (2) automate secret_id push to GH secrets, (3) KMS permission monitor alert. i'll create tickets and link to the runbook.
jen_platform: thanks all. closing this thread.
